basis: Analytic propagation of half-ULP uncertainty from TWO binary32 endpoint velocity measurements into mass*(v1-v0)/dt. Coasting initial speed2mm/s gives a different measurement resolution from the zero-velocity preload. This is an additional measurement-reference version, not a material/contact/force-path modification.
additional_velocity_rounding_bound: Per Cartesian component b_i=m*(0.5*abs(spacing(float32(v0_i)))+0.5*abs(spacing(float32(v1_i))))/robot_dt. Compare norm(momentum-rate residual) <=1e-6+norm(b). No fitted correction, offset subtraction, sign adjustment or observed force scale enters b.
reporting: Always retain original raw1e-6 force pass/fail separately. A new quantization-aware measurement pass must be explicitly labelled with its actual resolution; it cannot relabel an old failure or claim the original1micronewton moving-velocity accuracy.
scope: Measured instantaneous knife Newton-Euler force derivative at the three declared moving coupling clocks only. Integrated target/robot impulse, float32 applied wrench, force arithmetic, CAD action/reaction, kinetic/work budgets and all physical stops remain unchanged.
